dialogues.speaker: Castiglione
dialogues.text: A true tribute to the old masters while capturing the spirit... Not bad at all. This is what exquisite composition looks like!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you also a native of Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Castiglione
dialogues.text: Oh no, no, you're mistaken. I'm from the town of Petrichor in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Castiglione
dialogues.text: But I reasoned that, finding myself within this paradise-like locale amidst such splendor, it was only fitting to don the dress of a gentleman of Liyue here.

dialogues.speaker: Castiglione
dialogues.text: Oh. Should you chance upon Maukie, I pray you inform him that his use of trompe l'oeil is quite simply abysmal.
